sn49.1-12:1.3: In brief the four are the effort to prevent, to abandon, to arouse, and to perfect.
sn49.1-12:1.5: According to the Sutta analysis at [vb8](), the “bad unskillful qualities” are greed, hate, and delusion with associated phenomena. “Enthusiasm” (_chanda_) is the wholesome and righteous desire to practice.
